blinding_guess.why: All five listed elements are Gazebo sensors that the plugin looks up by names read at load time from its SDF block (bumper_name, cliff_sensor_left_name, cliff_sensor_center_name, cliff_sensor_right_name, imu_name); the robot description that supplies those names (kobuki_description, loaded by kobuki_gazebo/launch/includes/robot.launch.xml:7) is not in the snapshot. The plugin aborts Load if any of the five names or sensors is missing, so a mismatch with the description would be fatal, but nothing in this package alone shows one.

notes: All five packet elements are consumed resources (Gazebo sensors), none provided, so declares and not_declared are empty. The code never names 'bumpers', 'cliff_sensor_front', 'cliff_sensor_left', 'cliff_sensor_right' or 'imu': each sensor name is supplied at run time from the model's SDF plugin block via the elements bumper_name, cliff_sensor_left_name, cliff_sensor_center_name, cliff_sensor_right_name and imu_name (gazebo_ros_kobuki_loads.cpp:179-306) and looked up unscoped with sensors::SensorManager::Instance()->GetSensor(name); hence references is empty. The plugin has left/center/right cliff slots; mapping resource:cliff_sensor_front to the center slot rests on the code's own comments ('frontal cliff sensor'), and the actual name binding lives in the robot description outside the snapshot. Sensor classes consumed: sensors::ContactSensor (bumpers), sensors::RaySensor (three cliff sensors, GetRange(0)), sensors::ImuSensor (GetOrientation, GetAngularVelocity, GetLinearAcceleration); these are Gazebo C++ interfaces, not ROS message types, so msg_type and definition_id are null. Frames: the code hard-codes no frame for these sensor resources; a comment at gazebo_ros_kobuki_updates.cpp:285 says bumper contact positions are in world coordinates, and IMU data are re-published on <base_prefix>/sensors/imu_data with the joint-state header whose frame_id is resolveTF("base_link") (updates.cpp:47-49,146), but that is the published topic, not the consumed resource; recorded null. Units for IMU and bumper data are not stated in code; null. QoS null (ROS 1 / not ROS topics). No rate set for sensor reads; they are read on every world update (OnUpdate). exclusive is empty: the plugin calls SetActive(true) on each sensor and SetVelocity/SetMaxForce on wheel joints named at run time (left_wheel_joint_name, right_wheel_joint_name), but declares no exclusive claim. Recovery is package-level (velocity-command watchdog) and not tied to the listed sensors; if any listed sensor is missing, Load logs ROS_ERROR and returns without retry or fallback. ros_distro is null in the packet; the snapshot's kobuki_simulator.rosinstall pins 'indigo' branches, and the manifest is package format 1, version 0.4.1.
